question: Can a title select Oak, Oxen and Fish on existing same-terrain ring tiles without terrain stores, and what identity, visual, persistence and India ordering contracts follow?

dependencies.use: Accepted 22-row ordinal/terrain/remainder and native player-access gates; not re-derived as a new definition claim.
Accepted map topology, terrain snapshot, callback/manager retention, setup arm and raw plane serializer contracts.
Selected content namespace/filename identity and manual pre-load/successful-save sidecar seams.

scope.boundary: Ten separate exact-owner read sets, each at most eight functions; no transitive whole-program call-graph or alias proof.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra raw BL, split-constant, pointer, slot-call and memory queries; supported flat-file SHA-256 checked independently; native PPC64 big-endian decoding and exact generated-function header/next-header bounded reads. Saved analysis memory is not assumed byte-identical to the supported file outside the compared words.
currentEvidence.qualification: Word equality includes padding, inline data and bounded surrounding query words; it is not an instruction count or proof that every displayed owner was semantically exhausted. The arithmetic check tests definition selection, not guest execution, technology helpers, object creation or a save round trip.
currentEvidence.generatedSpanDigestEncoding: SHA-256 of the exact header-through-before-next-header function span encoded UTF-8 after normalizing line endings to LF; EOF bounds the final physical function. This is a normalized source-span identity, not a raw file digest.

directCallCensus.extent: Every aligned word of the supported 18939904-byte flat file was independently decoded as a possible direct B/BL to 0x82CF1558; the Ghidra initialized-executable raw BL scan agreed on 20 sites, without truncation. No additional direct non-link branch matched.

identityConsumers.conclusion: All 20 direct helper call sites are enumerated. No inline tile-to-ordinal duplicate is proved in the selected definition-base inventory. Universal identity-consumer coverage, especially minimap, strategic AI and monopoly aggregation, remains conditional.

overrideFeasibility.sameTerrainSelector: A pre-instruction midasm at 0x82CF15C4 can select the synthetic coordinate sum in full r8 using current tile index low32(r11), provided the requested row has the actual current terrain and all normal flags/bounds hold. At that point r11=i=40*a+b; r8 is a+b; r7 is the terrain base. Replace only r8 with the desired row remainder: Oak9 ->1 on terrain3, Oxen0 ->0 on terrain1, Fish18 ->2 on terrain0. Native 0x82CF15E4/15EC/15FC then computes that remainder; the ordinary row loop and technology/UEA39/civ10 gates remain. The earlier r6 overflow-trap operand still comes from the real coordinate sum; supported a,b in0..31 excludes its exceptional signed case. No terrain byte or definition changes are needed. Preserve all other registers/control and guest bytes; validate this generated hook at runtime.
overrideFeasibility.availability: An unconditional function-exit q replacement would bypass presence, forbidden flags and player availability. A post-return override also cannot recover a technology-rejected native identity reliably. Keep native row acceptance, -1 sentinel and valid ordinal0 semantics. The same-terrain remainder insertion avoids a second native candidate after an unavailable override because the accepted 22 pairs are unique.
overrideFeasibility.creation: In 0x82D7FCB0, returned q is retained in r26, forwarded as r6 at 0x82D7FD38 and passed to 0x82E54250 at FD44. Constructor 0x82E54280 stores q at object+0x78 and coordinates at+0x70/+0x74. FD58..FD68 obtains the definition name at 0x82F6FAD0+68*q, then FD84 calls object+0x14. Constructor-installed vtable0x82132AB8 has cell+0x14=0x82E544E8 at0x82132ACC. That setter normalizes/prepares the name at0x82E54540..45C8, stores object+0x10, and calls0x82C63320 at0x82E545D4. The latter supplies that name to resource lookup0x82C92950 at0x82C63364 or33D4. Its later q-specific placement work reads object+0x78 at0x82E54948. Thus fresh visual identity/model request follows q and its definition name, not a second coordinate remainder calculation. Asset lookup success, exact visible model, allocation/registration/lifetime and all helper returns remain conditions.
overrideFeasibility.existingObject: 0x82D7FD00..FD18 skips directly to FE2C on a nonempty query; it performs no q/name comparison or replacement. Existing visual objects need an independently proved teardown/recreation or safe setter/rebind path. Changing object+0x78 alone leaves its name/model and special-case state inconsistent. Calling+0xF4 again is not a replacement contract.
overrideFeasibility.ordering: 0x82D25254 calls setup0x82D217C8 before the recount call0x82D2530C ->0x82D11AD8 (LR0x82D25310). Setup already invokes+0xF4 at0x82D2332C and0x82D2455C/0x82D24768. A hook only at or after the recount cannot precede those resource creation attempts. Before recount is necessary for those cases, but not sufficient to prove the first resource object does not already exist. No exclusive all-native-writers-complete/visuals-empty seam is established. Freeze settings before setup; select/publish actual tile overrides before their first creation, or close replacement ownership. See resource-density-generation-boundary.json#/abundantLegendaryFeasibilityBoundary/mutationSeamBoundary for the joined selected scene-before-later-setup order and exact conditional0x82D86AD4 candidate. ExistingTitleState records actual deferred title publication and selected load restoration.

Load0x822DE720 loops1600 times, calling0x822DEC88 at0x822DE784 with each destination. The reader requests2 bytes from stream+4 at0x822DECB8 and optionally swaps them at0x822DED08..14. Conditional on paired completing streams/byte order and retained destinations, all16 bits transfer, including unclassified bits. This is transfer fidelity, not unusedness or a completed load/save result.

Unclassified bits are not certified free. No complete all-writer/all-reader/alias inventory proves any remaining bit or another plane unused and retained after load. Padding outside the active32x32 rectangle is not a certified extension field. The result does not prove no spare storage exists.

sidecarDesign.classification: proposed title contract; not an existing native format
sidecarDesign.identity: Use selected user/device content namespace plus normalized internal filename at selected record+0x108. Bind sidecar to native save content digest (or an equally strong generation identity), schema and effective rule version/configuration, so overwriting/copying a same-name native slot cannot silently reuse stale overrides.
sidecarDesign.payload: Store the frozen resource/India policy and sorted unique sparse (tileIndex U16,resourceOrdinal U8) entries; expected terrain follows the ordinal definition for this same-terrain policy. Three entries require9 bytes for the sparse records, before version/flags/count/identity. This is a simple sufficient representation, not an information-theoretic minimum. Exactly fixed Oak/Oxen/Fish roles can instead use three U16 tile indices (6 bytes) per three-role set plus absence encoding and header; additional player sets/overlaps require count and conflict policy. Do not save transient object pointers or reroll from a current cvar on load.
sidecarDesign.save: Reuse the manual successful-save result edge0x82D829E8, r25!=0, filename throughr29, from save-slot-ruleset-identity. Snapshot override state with the native save and atomically replace its sidecar only after final native success. A native-save failure leaves the old sidecar untouched. After native success, sidecar write/replacement failure or a crash can leave a mismatched pair; digest binding detects that condition but does not preserve the previous native save. Preserving the previous pair requires native backup/rollback or a joint transaction. Report sidecar failure and reject mismatched loads under the selected compatibility policy. Autosave/other storage routes need equivalent success/identity evidence.
sidecarDesign.load: At manual load entry0x82D84238, before native deserializer bctrl0x82D844C8(return0x82D844CC), validate the matching sidecar and prepare its frozen snapshot; install it before the first post-load identity/model consumer. Clear prior-game overrides without clearing the newly selected snapshot at a later reset hook. Stage/commit/rollback around load failure and absent/mismatched sidecar behavior must be explicit. The existing0x82D86674 reset is before mode-one plane transfer, not a proved complete resource reconstruction boundary.

existingTitleState.setup: SetupScope in the raw sub_82D25170 wrapper clears overrides, freezes mode and stages pending selection before native setup. There is no direct tile-publication hook at0x82D25254. At the LR0x82D25310 recount wrapper, optional AI removal precedes OnNewGameSetup/Apply. Apply consumes selection, clears again, builds/publishes records, then writes presence and calls refresh; the original native recount follows. Earlier publication would be cleared by this lifecycle. No successful all-consumer/native-runtime order is implied.
existingTitleState.india: Pending Balanced mode is consulted at0x82D23324 and can skip to0x82D23330 before recount. Thus current resource policy freeze is early enough in this inspected source, while AI resolution/tile publication remain later. The native explicit-draw preservation and omitted-callback qualifications in india remain unchanged.
existingTitleState.load: Raw sub_82D84238 transaction captures selected normalized native filename; pre0x82D844C8 hook stages schema/content-digest-validated sidecar before the deserializer bctrl (return0x82D844CC). Pre-BL0x82D86674 hook runs ResetOnLoad clear then RestoreAfterLoadReset; resource snapshot is atomically published before other frozen settings and original native BL resumes. mutationSeamBoundary in resource-density-generation-boundary.json proves the selected later plane/sweep order, not every load consumer.
existingTitleState.save: Final-result hook0x82D829E8 requires r25!=0, active captured save transaction and native filename. It writes/flushes a temporary sidecar and atomically replaces it after native success with native-content SHA256. Sidecar failure logs and does not roll back the native save. Distinct autosave routes remain uncertified.
existingTitleState.failure: Missing/rejected/mismatched sidecars stage no state and log fallback; reset leaves an empty override snapshot with live settings if nothing is restored. Pending state is transaction-local; staged-but-unrestored state warns. No native-load rollback or whole-load transaction success is supplied.
existingTitleState.qualification: Read-only source/config evidence at the pinned implementation revision and exact file digests; not a claim that every checkout, emitted hook or running binary has this implementation. Source order and configured hooks do not prove runtime effect, peer parity, all earlier/alternate load consumers or the mixed-identity cause.

forest.unchangedTerrain: Keeping terrain3 leaves the terrain snapshot/classification unchanged. Adding0x20 alone does not alter the0x82D64B18 branch mask0x411. Its+0x120 target forwards to0x82E3DC18, which queries matching tree-class payloads and returns the first object+0x7C or-1. Its+0x118 target forwards to0x82E3DCF0, which queries that class and calls each current object+0x48 with the selectedf1. These query/child continuations require actual live objects, finite stable lists and returning callbacks.
forest.oakSpecialCase: The resource setter compares stored q with5 and9 at0x82E54954..49DC. Both select0x82E54C14..4C30, calling current A+0x11C with(a,b,7,0). Initialized0x82D7ED00 forwards to0x82E3DC80, which queries the same class and calls0x82E3D7D0 on its first result. For a retained child model type3, that helper selects mask bits1,4,2, resolves child0/1/2 by name and calls0x8234BDB8(child,1,1) at0x82E3D8FC/3978/39F4. 0x8234BDF0 stores old child halfword+0xA8 OR1, and its selected recursive path repeats for children. Thus native Oak creation can change existing Forest child scene flags without changing terrain. Exact names/asset appearance and rendered culling behavior remain runtime/asset gates.
forest.verdictDetail: Fresh same-terrain Oak uses the correct native ordinal/name request conditionally. The stronger claim that all existing tree scene state remains unchanged is disproved by the native child-flag writes. Whether the resulting visible Oak/Forest drawing satisfies a desired appearance needs a runtime comparison; bypassing the Oak child operation would be an additional title visual-policy change, not a consequence of preserving terrain.

india.testedPremise: The native civ10 arm occurs after recount and can be removed wholesale without changing RNG consumption or another continuation input.
india.order: Native setup0x82D25254 contains civ10 arm0x82D23268..23330 before successful recount0x82D2530C/LR0x82D25310. Recount-only resolution cannot control it. Inspected current resource source instead freezes/stages before the containing native function and consults pending Balanced at the store hook; see persistence/existingTitleState. Tile publication is still deferred until recount.
india.rng: The admitted arm advances RNG counter at0x82D2328C and state at0x82D2329C; a nonzero modulus can write the reduced state at0x82D232B4. Jumping from the civ10 compare/arm entry to the continuation drops this native draw and changes subsequent RNG inputs. No complete callback-transitive RNG equality is claimed.
india.narrowSkip: A title midasm before0x82D23324 can, under the earlier frozen setting, branch to0x82D23330 (then native branch0x82D23938), skipping the exact presence store, mtctr and+0xF4 bctrl while retaining the preceding native RNG update and offset calculation. Hook0x82D23320 may also skip the non-storing ori. Branching only around the call leaves presence set; suppressing only the store still runs refresh. Preserve original r17/player,r22/count pointer,r25/r26 coordinates, frame and saved state. No arbitrary r3 success value is required: immediately after the callback only an unconditional branch and count reload precede the common session lookup; no callback r3 scalar is tested or accumulated.
india.qualification: This proves local control/dataflow and retained explicit RNG draw, not equality of omitted callback writes, further RNG usage, floating/control state or whole-setup outcome. The skipped refresh intentionally omits its resource/Forest effects. Actual midasm placement, earlier frozen host/peer state and title runtime continuation remain gates.

runtimeEvidence.overrideObservation: Owner-reported Balanced identity override produced mixed Oxen/Cattle effects; no exact trace-build, ordered caller/result capture or new runtime execution is established in this record.
runtimeEvidence.terrainSwapContext: The reported terrain-swap observation (Oak drawn on water/desert while the old Forest still drew trees) corroborates the existing terrain-snapshot boundary. It is not an observation of an identity override, fresh-object creation, unchanged Oak trees, India suppression or save/reload. No new runtime execution was performed.

mixedIdentityObservation.observation: A Balanced Oxen override on Grassland whose native coordinate remainder selects Cattle behaved as Oxen while Romans with Code of Laws also received Cattle food.
mixedIdentityObservation.implication: Universal consumer agreement is not admitted. The20 direct-reader calls and bounded no-inline-duplicate result remain accurate static coverage, not a proof that all bonuses and caches use the overridden identity.
mixedIdentityObservation.alternatives: A pre-override cached city resource bitset/credit, an independently derived bonus identity, a bypass or an incorrect hook/context/order remains possible. No specific cause is selected.
mixedIdentityObservation.discriminator: Bind actual build, normalized tile, hook entry/exit/context/selected q, Roman Code of Laws contribution and city resource-bit reset/build order. Follow the first disagreeing live or cached consumer; do not repeat the closed base-construction census without that new evidence.

guards: Do not report every resource consumer proved from a direct caller census or an empty decoded reference set.
Do not treat an unclassified, serialized bit as unused or stable through later native writers.
Do not treat fresh-object name/type routing as proved asset fulfillment or a safe existing-object replacement.
Do not place the India freeze at0x82D25310 and claim it controls the earlier setup arm.
Do not promise identical Forest children from unchanged terrain: Oak selects a native child-state mutation.
implementerContract: Freeze the per-game resource/India policy before0x82D25254. Use canonical32x32 coordinates, first-coordinate wrap/second-coordinate clipping, stride40, unique physical indices and a deterministic finite policy for missing kinds/overlapping rings.

Publish same-terrain sparse q overrides before each selected tile first creates its visual. Preserve terrain bytes, flags other than required presence, native forbidden masks and player availability. Candidate selector0x82CF15C4 can change onlyr8 to the chosen remainder using currentr11=i; validate the emitted hook and all affected consumers.

Fresh visual path is0x82D7D974 ->A+0x248/0x82D7FCB0 ->0x82E54250 ->object+0x14/0x82E544E8. A nonempty resource query needs a separately proved replacement/rebind path; the after-setup recount is too late for setup refresh attempts.

Use a versioned slot-bound/digest-bound save sidecar until a native unused-field proof exists. Hydrate before load identity/model consumers and commit only after native save success; extend host settings if the policy is shared.
For India retain the native draw, then conditionally skip0x82D23324..2332C to0x82D23330. Do not claim wholesale-arm RNG parity or callback-global side-effect equality.

Open acceptance gates: minimap/strategic-AI/monopoly consumer ownership, an actual pre-first-object ordering or replacement contract, native Oak child appearance policy, successful model registration/retention, sidecar load/failure/autosave coverage, unchanged terrain plane, availability/yield/UI parity, and save/reload plus peer agreement.
falsificationCondition: A new exact identity reader/inline construction, a mismatched native operand, another matched definition pair, a different current vtable, native flag/plane reinterpretation, an earlier/later actual setting publication, or runtime object/stream behavior outside the stated guards rejects the corresponding extension. Re-entry needs that concrete discriminator, not repetition of the closed direct/base-construction scans.
conclusion: Terrain-preserving same-terrain resource selection has a conditional common-reader hook and fresh-object name/type route. A complete no-visible-change feature is not proved: native Oak changes Forest child flags, existing objects are not automatically rebound, no spare persisted tile field is certified, and the current recount setting freeze follows the India arm. The narrower India skip preserves its explicit RNG draw and ignores no consumed scalar return.
